Welcome to Sno Research. This is a future one-stop shop for data and analysis on money markets, financial plumbing, and macroeconomic frameworks. Separately, but not secondarily, Sno Research equally covers metals markets and their financial plumbing, liquidity managemnet, and their macroeconomic backdrop. Data and analysis are underpinned using quantitative methods in a transparent and rigorous form.

* Repo Rates Monitor

* Trade Finance

* Quantitative Methods
